title: Herdr keys sent
description: HERDR-3: the reply to `POST /v1/herdr/panes/{pane}/keys {"keys": [...]}`. The keys went to the pane as one `pane.send_keys` on the session socket: no controller was taken and the pane was not resized. Request keys are Herdr's names - `Escape` (`esc`), `Tab`, `Enter`, `Space`, `Backspace`, `Up`, `Down`, `Left`, `Right`, `F1`-`F12`, one printable character, or `ctrl+`/`alt+`/`shift+` joined to one of those (`shift+tab`, `ctrl+c`) - one to 32 per call. `PageUp`, `PageDown`, `Home`, `End`, `Insert` and `Delete` are `400 herdr_key_unsupported`; anything else is `400 invalid_key`.
